description: This file defines the ChartService class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It provides methods for retrieving and processing employee distribution data by subunit and location, utilizing the ChartDao for data access. The class includes logic for sorting, slicing, and computing unassigned employee counts, primarily supporting data aggregation for dashboard visualizations.

classes.name: ChartService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to retrieve and process employee distribution charts data for dashboard visualization.

methods.name: getChartDao
methods.description: Returns the ChartDao instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves and processes employee distribution data by subunit, limiting results and aggregating others.

methods.name: getLocationUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of unassigned employees based on total active employees minus assigned counts.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves and processes employee distribution data by location, including unassigned employees.
